question: Which state recorded the lowest unemployment rate according to the PLFS 2022-23?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) 2022-23, **Tripura** **recorded the lowest unemployment rate** among all Indian states.
 
• The unemployment rate in Tripura was **just 1.4%**, reflecting its robust industrial and economic ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)**

 
 
• Launched by the National Statistical Office (NSO) in 2022-23, PLFS aims to provide annual and quarterly estimates of key employment and unemployment indicators.
 
• It covers rural and urban areas, focusing on the labor market's dynamics and trends.
 
• The survey uses indicators such as the Worker Population Ratio (WPR), Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR), and Unemployment Rate (UR).
 
 
 
• **Unemployment Rate**
 
 
• It is defined as the percentage of persons in the labor force who are unemployed and actively seeking work.
 
• Low unemployment rates indicate a healthy labor market and economic stability.
 
 
 
• **Other States with Low Unemployment Rates**
 
 
• According to PLFS 2022-23, states like Karnataka and Maharashtra also reported low unemployment rates due to their strong industrial and service sectors.
